s1.title: There's always something going on
s1.intro: Pancake breakfasts, Bingo nights, home-cooked dinners, meetings with guest speakers — and the biggest day of our year, the Fourth of July Picnic in the Park.

box_1.heading: Legion Dining Room & Club 432
box_1.text: At the back of the Veterans Memorial Hall, 1000 Main Street, Cambria.

box_2.text: Who's welcome? Pancake breakfasts and Bingo are open to everyone. Club nights and dinners are for members and their guests — come as a guest of a member, or join us.

s5.heading: Post, Auxiliary & Club calendar
s5.text: Kept up to date by the Post and Auxiliary in Google Calendar. On a phone, it shows as a list.
